  • Constructor Details

    • GlassyPanel

      public GlassyPanel(float width, float height, float depth, Appearance app)
      Create a GlassyRingPanel object. The shape's foremost surface will be placed on the Z=0 plane with X=0, Y=0 at the center.
      Parameters:
      width - Width of the panel.
      height - Height of the panel.
      depth - Z depth of the panel.
      app - Appearance to use.

    • GlassyPanel

      public GlassyPanel(float width, float height, float depth, float edge, Appearance app)
      Create a GlassyRingPanel object. The shape's foremost surface will be placed on the Z=0 plane with X=0, Y=0 at the center.
      Parameters:
      width - Width of the panel.
      height - Height of the panel.
      depth - Z depth of the panel.
      edge - Width of the fuzzy area around the edge.
      app - Appearance to use.

    • GlassyPanel

      public GlassyPanel(float width, float height, float depth, float edge, float xShift, float yShift, float zShift, Appearance app)
      Create a GlassyRingPanel object. The shape's foremost surface will be placed on the Z=zShift plane with X=xShift, Y=yShift at the center.
      Parameters:
      width - Width of the panel.
      height - Height of the panel.
      depth - Z depth of the panel.
      edge - Width of the fuzzy area around the edge.
      xShift - Coordinate bias toward the X direction.
      yShift - Coordinate bias toward the Y direction.
      zShift - Coordinate bias toward the X direction.
      app - Appearance to use.
